$comment: Every work that can be seen in each picture the site can show, and its licence. A picture with no record here is left out of the site. "<theme>/<id>" records a themed copy that shows different works from the plain one. Checked against D:/WittyDemoMedia/credits.json (each licence read from its source on the date in "fetched") and, for the project’s own drawings, the repositories. See the report of 2026-11-04 for pictures left out on purpose.
